examples.en: The test detected bacteria.
The machine detects even small bits of metal.

examples.ko: 연구팀이 물에서 중금속을 검출한 사실을 알렸어요.
examples.en: The research team announced that they detected heavy metals in the water.

examples.ko: 이 장치로 연기를 검출할 수 있어요.
examples.en: You can detect smoke with this device.
It is hard to detect a weak signal.

examples.ko: 오염 물질을 검출하면 바로 연락 주세요.
examples.en: If you detect a pollutant, please contact us right away.

explain: '검출하다'는 검사나 기계로 숨어 있는 물질이나 신호를 찾아낼 때 쓰고, 과학과 뉴스에서 자주 나와요. 그냥 물건을 찾을 때는 '찾다'를 써요. '발견하다'는 우연히 알게 될 때도 쓰지만 검출하다는 도구를 쓴 결과예요.

phrases.en: Bacteria were detected in the water.
phrases.nuance_ko: 검사 결과 찾아졌다는 뜻으로 뉴스에서 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means something was found by testing, common in the news.

phrases.example: 이 장치는 가스를 빨리 검출해 내요.
phrases.en: This device quickly detects gas.
phrases.nuance_ko: '-아/어 내다'를 붙여 힘들게 찾아낸다는 느낌을 더해요.
phrases.nuance_en: '-아/어 내다' adds the sense of successfully finding it.

phrases.en: The detection result will come out tomorrow.
phrases.nuance_ko: 검사로 찾은 것에 대한 결과를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers to the result of testing for something.

explain_en: Pick out a trace substance in lab or inspection (먼지를 검출하다) 검출하다 is used when a test or machine finds a hidden substance or signal, and it appears often in science and the news. For simply looking for an object, use 찾다. 발견하다 can also be an accidental discovery, but 검출하다 is a result obtained with a tool.

en: to be reviewed; to be examined

examples.en: Your application is being reviewed now.
That plan has been reviewed several times.
I'll tell you tomorrow what was reviewed.
It has to be checked thoroughly for problems.
Once the new policy is reviewed, we'll announce it.

examples.ko: 그 안은 비용 때문에 검토되지 않았어요.
examples.en: That proposal wasn't considered because of the cost.

explain: 검토하는 사람이 아니라 검토를 받는 서류·계획·안건이 주어예요. '지금 검토 중이에요'라고도 말해요. 회사나 관공서에서 '검토 후 연락드리겠습니다'처럼 쓰는 말과 이어져요.

phrases.en: The documents are under review right now.
phrases.nuance_ko: 아직 확인하는 일이 끝나지 않았을 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when the checking is still going on.

phrases.en: That issue will be reviewed again.
phrases.nuance_ko: '다시'를 붙여 한 번 더 살펴본다는 뜻을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Adding '다시' means it will be looked at once more.

phrases.en: Many opinions were reviewed carefully.
phrases.nuance_ko: 꼼꼼하게 살펴봤다는 뜻을 더해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Adds the sense that it was examined carefully.

explain_en: Passive; a plan or proposal is under careful review. The subject is the document, plan, or agenda item being reviewed, not the reviewer. You can also say '지금 검토 중이에요'. It connects to phrases used at companies and offices, such as '검토 후 연락드리겠습니다'.

examples.en: If the denominators are the same, you just add the numerators.
I found a common denominator for the two fractions.
I learned that the denominator cannot be zero.

examples.ko: 선생님이 분모와 분자를 헷갈리지 말라고 하셨어요.
examples.en: The teacher told us not to mix up the denominator and numerator.

examples.ko: 분자가 같을 때는 분모가 클수록 값이 작아요.
examples.en: When the numerators are the same, a bigger denominator means a smaller value.
In this problem you have to multiply the denominator by 3.

explain: 짝이 되는 말 '분자'와 함께 외워요. 분수를 읽을 때는 '삼분의 이'처럼 분모를 먼저 읽어요. 수학 말고도 '공통분모'라는 비유로 일상에서 자주 써요.

phrases.example: 두 사람의 공통분모는 음악을 좋아한다는 점이에요.
phrases.en: What the two of them have in common is that they love music.
phrases.nuance_ko: 서로 다른 사람이나 의견 사이에 같은 점을 말할 때 비유로 써요. 보통 '공통분모를 찾다'라고 해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used figuratively for the shared point between different people or opinions. You often say '공통분모를 찾다'.

explain_en: Learn it together with its partner '분자' (numerator). When reading fractions aloud, you say the denominator first, as in '삼분의 이' (two thirds). Outside math, it is used figuratively in '공통분모'.

en: to be described; to be narrated; to be stated

examples.ko: 사건의 과정이 책에 자세히 서술되어 있어요.
examples.en: The course of the incident is described in detail in the book.
I was surprised that what was written differed from the facts.

examples.ko: 인물의 마음이 길게 서술되는 소설을 좋아해요.
examples.en: I like novels in which a character's feelings are described at length.
This part is described briefly.

examples.ko: 방법이 순서대로 서술되면 따라 하기 쉬워요.
examples.en: When the method is laid out in order, it is easy to follow.
I am more curious about the story that was not told.

explain: 글이나 책에서 어떤 내용이 차례대로 쓰여 있을 때 써요. 말로 하는 설명에는 잘 안 쓰고, 논문, 기사, 시험 문제에 많아요. '서술형 문제'는 짧은 답이 아니라 문장으로 길게 쓰는 문제예요.

phrases.example: 이 책에는 그 시대의 생활이 서술돼 있어요.
phrases.en: Life in that era is described in this book.
phrases.nuance_ko: 글에 내용이 쓰여 있는 상태를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for the state of content being written in a text.

phrases.en: I described the course of the event in order.
phrases.nuance_ko: 사람이 글로 차례대로 쓰는 일은 능동형 '서술하다'로 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: The active form, for a person writing things out in order.

phrases.example: 서술형 문제는 답을 길게 써야 해요.
phrases.en: For essay-type questions you have to write a long answer.
phrases.nuance_ko: 시험에서 문장으로 길게 쓰는 문제를 가리키는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A common term for exam questions answered in full sentences.

explain_en: Passive — told in order, as a narrative. It is used when content is written out in order in a text or book. It is rarely used for spoken explanations and is common in papers, articles, and exam questions. A '서술형 문제' is a question where you write your answer in full sentences rather than giving a short answer.

dis.h: told in order, as a narrative
gh: explained factually, as in a report
shown vividly in words or art

p.n: 기술되다 sounds more like a neutral factual record; 서술되다 stresses telling it step by step.

en: to be included; to be printed in

examples.en: This poem is included in the textbook.
That song was included on the new album.

examples.ko: 사전에 수록된 단어는 십만 개가 넘어요.
examples.en: The dictionary has more than a hundred thousand entries.

examples.ko: 이 책에는 유명한 작가의 글이 열 편 수록돼 있어요.
examples.en: This book contains ten pieces by famous writers.

examples.ko: 제 사진이 다음 호 잡지에 수록될 예정이에요.
examples.en: My photo is scheduled to appear in the next issue of the magazine.

examples.ko: 수록되지 않은 단어는 따로 찾아봐야 해요.
examples.en: Words that are not included have to be looked up separately.

explain: 책, 앨범, 사전처럼 여러 항목을 모은 곳에 글, 곡, 단어가 담길 때 써요. '~에 수록되다'가 기본 형태예요. 말할 때는 '실리다', '들어 있다'가 더 쉬워요.

phrases.en: My writing was printed in a magazine.
phrases.nuance_ko: 말할 때 '수록되다' 대신 쓰는 쉬운 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: An easier word used in speech instead of 수록되다.

phrases.example: 이 앨범에 수록된 노래가 다 좋아요.
phrases.en: All the songs on this album are good.
phrases.nuance_ko: '수록되다'가 뒤의 명사를 꾸미는 형태예요.
phrases.nuance_en: The modifier form placed before a noun.

phrases.example: 그 단어는 이 사전에 수록되지 않았어요.
phrases.en: That word isn't included in this dictionary.
phrases.nuance_ko: 어떤 책이나 모음집에 들어 있지 않다는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Says that something is not in a given book or collection.

explain_en: Passive; appears in a dictionary, album or collection. Use it when a piece of writing, a song or a word is gathered into a collection such as a book, album or dictionary. The basic pattern is '~에 수록되다'. In speech, '실리다' or '들어 있다' is easier.

dis.h: printed in a book, album or collection
gh: general; counted as part of something

t90.ax: This poem is included in the textbook.

examples.ko: 영어 숙어를 외우는 게 쉽지 않아요.
examples.en: Memorizing English idioms is not easy.

examples.ko: 이 숙어는 글자 그대로 해석하면 뜻이 이상해요.
examples.en: If you translate this idiom word for word, the meaning comes out strange.
I organized the idioms that often appear on tests.

examples.ko: 숙어 사전을 찾아보니 비슷한 표현이 많았어요.
examples.en: I looked in an idiom dictionary and found many similar expressions.

examples.ko: 한국어 숙어를 배우면 대화가 훨씬 자연스러워져요.
examples.en: If you learn Korean idioms, your conversation becomes much more natural.

examples.ko: 선생님이 숙어 하나를 예문과 함께 알려 주셨어요.
examples.en: The teacher taught us an idiom together with example sentences.

explain: 영어 공부할 때 '숙어'라는 말을 많이 쓰고, 한국어 표현에는 '관용구'나 '관용어'를 자주 써요. '고개가 숙어지다'의 '숙어'는 '숙다'가 바뀐 모양이라 소리만 같고 다른 말이에요.

phrases.en: I'm learning Korean idioms one by one.
phrases.nuance_ko: 한국어 표현에는 '숙어'보다 '관용구'를 더 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: For Korean expressions, 관용구 is used more often than 숙어.

phrases.en: I memorize idioms before the exam.
phrases.nuance_ko: 공부할 때 가장 자주 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common pairing when studying.

phrases.example: 영어 숙어를 매일 다섯 개씩 외워요.
phrases.en: I memorize five English idioms every day.
phrases.nuance_ko: 영어 공부 이야기에서 가장 자주 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common pairing when talking about studying English.

explain_en: '숙어' is the word used most when studying English, while for Korean expressions people often say '관용구' or '관용어'. The '숙어' in '고개가 숙어지다' is a form of '숙다' (to bow), so it only sounds the same.

t90.ax: Memorizing English idioms is not easy.

examples.en: This academy has a well-organized curriculum.
I signed up for the class after looking at the curriculum.
The curriculum is set up as a three-month course.
The new curriculum has more speaking time.
If we follow the curriculum exactly, time is tight.

examples.ko: 선생님이 커리큘럼 안에서 숙제를 내 주셨어요.
examples.en: The teacher gave homework within the curriculum.

explain: 학교에서 나라가 정한 것은 '교육과정'이라고 하고, 학원이나 강의에서 짠 것은 '커리큘럼'이라고 부르기도 해요. '커리큘럼을 짜다', '커리큘럼을 따르다'처럼 써요.

phrases.example: 선생님이 새 수업 커리큘럼을 짜고 있어요.
phrases.en: The teacher is putting together a new class curriculum.
phrases.nuance_ko: 수업 계획을 만들 때 '짜다'를 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use '짜다' for putting together a plan.

phrases.en: We study following the academy's curriculum.
phrases.nuance_ko: 정해진 순서대로 공부할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use this when studying in a set order.

phrases.en: I'll send you the class curriculum in advance.
phrases.nuance_ko: 수업 내용과 순서를 말할 때 앞에 '수업'을 붙여요.
phrases.nuance_en: Put '수업' before it to mean the lesson contents and order.

explain_en: What the state sets for schools is called '교육과정', while what an academy or a course puts together is also called a '커리큘럼'. It goes with '커리큘럼을 짜다' and '커리큘럼을 따르다'.

examples.ko: 한국 현대사를 공부하면 지금 사회가 이해돼요.
examples.en: Studying modern Korean history helps me understand society today.
I took a modern history class at university.

examples.ko: 이 영화는 현대사의 아픈 장면을 보여 줘요.
examples.en: This film shows painful scenes from modern history.

examples.ko: 현대사 책은 읽을수록 궁금한 게 많아져요.
examples.en: The more I read modern history books, the more questions I have.
My grandfather's story is itself Korean modern history.

examples.ko: 세계 현대사 시험이 내일이라 밤새 외웠어요.
examples.en: The world modern history exam is tomorrow, so I memorized all night.

explain: '역사'는 과거 전체를 말하고, 현대사는 우리와 가까운 시대의 역사예요. 어디부터를 현대로 보느냐는 나라와 책마다 달라요. '한국 현대사', '세계 현대사'처럼 앞에 범위를 붙여 써요.

phrases.example: 한국 현대사 책을 한 권 읽었어요.
phrases.en: I read a book on modern Korean history.
phrases.nuance_ko: 앞에 나라를 붙여서 어느 나라의 현대사인지 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Put a country in front to say whose modern history you mean.

phrases.en: World modern history covers a wide range for the exam.
phrases.nuance_ko: 한 나라가 아니라 세계 전체의 가까운 역사를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use it for recent history of the whole world, not one country.

phrases.en: I learn modern history at school.
phrases.nuance_ko: '현대사'에 '배우다'를 붙여 공부하는 일을 말하는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A common pairing with 'learn' for talking about studying it.

explain_en: School subject covering the period from roughly the mid-20th century onward. 역사 covers the whole past, while 현대사 is the history of the era close to us. Where 'modern' begins differs by country and by book. Put the scope in front, as in 한국 현대사 or 세계 현대사.

t90.ax: I took a modern history class at university.

en: East Asian painting; traditional Asian painting

examples.ko: 동양화에서는 그림이 없는 여백도 표현의 일부로 여겨요.
examples.en: In Eastern painting, the empty space is also seen as part of the expression.
I saw an Eastern painting exhibition at the art museum.
My grandfather paints Eastern-style paintings as a hobby.

examples.ko: 동양화는 먹과 붓으로 그린 그림이 많아요.
examples.en: Many Eastern paintings are made with ink and brush.

examples.ko: 이 동양화에는 산과 물이 그려져 있어요.
examples.en: Mountains and water are painted in this Eastern painting.
Eastern and Western paintings feel very different.

explain: 반대말은 '서양화'예요. 한국에서는 '한국화'라는 말도 많이 쓰고, 보통 먹과 붓으로 그린 그림을 떠올려요.

phrases.en: My grandfather paints oriental paintings.
phrases.nuance_ko: 그림을 '그리다'와 함께 가장 기본으로 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most basic pairing with 'to draw/paint'.

phrases.en: Western and oriental paintings feel different.
phrases.nuance_ko: 반대말과 같이 놓고 비교할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when comparing with its opposite.

phrases.en: Korean-style paintings are usually done with ink and a brush.
phrases.nuance_ko: 한국에서 '동양화' 대신 많이 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A term often used in Korea in place of 동양화.

explain_en: The opposite is '서양화'. In Korea the word '한국화' is also widely used, and people usually picture paintings done with ink and brush.

examples.en: I saw a folk painting with a tiger at the museum.

examples.ko: 할머니 댁 병풍에 민화가 그려져 있어요.
examples.en: A folk painting is drawn on the folding screen at Grandma's house.

examples.ko: 민화 속 호랑이는 무섭지 않고 귀여워요.
examples.en: The tiger in folk paintings isn't scary but cute.
I learn folk painting at the culture center every weekend.

examples.ko: 이 가방에는 민화 무늬가 들어가 있어요.
examples.en: This bag has a folk painting pattern on it.
I gave a folk painting to my foreign friend as a gift.

explain: 예전에 보통 사람들이 집에서 즐기고 걸어 두던 그림이에요. 호랑이와 까치 그림이 특히 유명해요. 요즘은 배우는 수업이나 상품 무늬로도 인기가 있어요.

phrases.en: I paint folk paintings every weekend.
phrases.nuance_ko: 취미나 수업에서 직접 민화를 만든다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: This means making folk paintings yourself as a hobby or in a class.

phrases.example: 민화 수업에서 붓 쓰는 법을 배웠어요.
phrases.en: I learned how to use a brush in the folk painting class.
phrases.nuance_ko: 요즘 문화센터 등에서 인기 있는 수업 이름이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: This is the name of a class that is popular these days at culture centers.

phrases.example: 까치호랑이 민화는 보기만 해도 웃음이 나요.
phrases.en: The magpie and tiger folk painting makes me smile just by looking at it.
phrases.nuance_ko: 가장 유명한 민화 그림 종류를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: This refers to the most famous type of folk painting.

explain_en: Traditional Korean painting by common people (호랑이 민화) These are paintings that ordinary people once enjoyed and hung at home. Pictures of a tiger and a magpie are especially famous. Today they are also popular as classes to learn and as patterns on products.

examples.en: The dove is a symbol of peace.
This city's emblem is a tall tower.
We chose the tiger as the school's emblem.

examples.ko: 상징물을 보면 그 나라의 문화를 알 수 있어요.
examples.en: You can learn a country's culture from its symbols.
The rose of Sharon is one of our country's symbols.
We are making a new company emblem.

explain: 나라, 도시, 학교, 회사처럼 어떤 단체를 대표하는 물건이나 동물에 써요. '상징'은 평화, 사랑 같은 생각에도 쓰지만 '상징물'은 눈에 보이는 것에만 써요. '마스코트'는 캐릭터 느낌이 더 강해요.

phrases.en: A white dove is a symbol of peace.
phrases.nuance_ko: '~의 상징물'은 무엇을 대표하는 물건인지 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: 'X의 상징물' tells what the object stands for.

phrases.en: This statue is the symbol of our city.
phrases.nuance_ko: 도시나 나라를 대표하는 눈에 보이는 것에 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for a visible thing that represents a city or country.

phrases.en: That tower became the symbol of the school.
phrases.nuance_ko: 어떤 물건이 대표하는 것이 되었다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: It means an object has come to represent something.

explain_en: Emblem — a concrete object representing a place or group (이 도시를 대표하는 상징물은 광장에 서 있는 커다란 탑이에요.) It is used for an object or animal that represents a country, city, school, or company. '상징' also covers ideas like peace or love, but '상징물' covers only visible things. '마스코트' feels more like a character.

t90.ax: The dove is a symbol of peace.

examples.ko: 이 카페는 서구식 인테리어에 한국식 메뉴를 팔아요.
examples.en: This cafe has a Western-style interior and sells Korean-style menu items.
Our family eats breakfast Western style.

examples.ko: 결혼식을 서구식이 아니라 전통 방식으로 올렸어요.
examples.en: We held the wedding in the traditional way, not Western style.

examples.ko: 할머니는 서구식은 입에 안 맞는다며 한식만 드세요.
examples.en: My grandmother says Western-style food doesn't suit her taste and eats only Korean food.

examples.ko: 개화기에는 서구식과 전통 방식이 섞인 집이 많았어요.
examples.en: In the enlightenment period, there were many houses mixing Western and traditional styles.
She is an international student used to Western ways, so she is clumsy with chopsticks.

explain: '서양식'과 비슷하지만 '서구식'은 유럽과 미국의 방식이라는 느낌이 있어서 글이나 설명문에 더 어울려요. 입말에서는 '서양식'이 더 편하게 들리고, 음식은 '양식'이라고도 해요.

phrases.en: We had a Western-style dinner.
phrases.nuance_ko: 뜻은 비슷하지만 말할 때 더 편하게 들려요.
phrases.nuance_en: The meaning is similar, but it sounds more natural in speech.

phrases.example: 이 학교는 서구식 교육을 따르고 있어요.
phrases.en: This school follows a Western-style education.
phrases.nuance_ko: 교육이나 제도를 설명하는 글에서 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often used in writing that explains education or systems.

phrases.example: 서구식 생활 방식이 점점 퍼지고 있어요.
phrases.en: A Western lifestyle is spreading more and more.
phrases.nuance_ko: 사회의 변화를 설명할 때 쓰는 딱딱한 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A formal expression used when explaining social change.

explain_en: It is close to '서양식', but '서구식' suggests the ways of Europe and America and fits writing and explanations better. In speech '서양식' sounds more natural, and for food people also say '양식'.

t90.ax: Our family eats breakfast Western style.

examples.en: My deaf friend talks in sign language.

examples.ko: 뉴스 화면 아래쪽에 수어 통역이 나와요.
examples.en: A sign language interpreter appears at the bottom of the news screen.
I started studying sign language.
A sign language club has started at our school.
In sign language, you speak with hand shapes and facial expressions.

examples.ko: 그 배우는 영화를 위해 수어를 몇 달 연습했어요.
examples.en: The actor practiced sign language for months for the movie.

explain: 예전에는 '수화'라고 많이 불렀지만, 지금은 '수어'를 공식으로 써요. 한국수어는 한국어를 손으로 옮긴 것이 아니라 문법이 다른 독립된 언어예요. 쓰는 사람은 '수어 사용자'라고 해요.

phrases.en: My friend greeted me in sign language.
phrases.nuance_ko: 수어를 수단으로 쓸 때 조사 '로'를 붙여요.
phrases.nuance_en: Attach the particle 로 when sign language is the means.

phrases.en: The presentation has sign language interpretation.
phrases.nuance_ko: 행사나 뉴스에서 자주 보이는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A pairing often seen at events and on the news.

phrases.en: I learn sign language every weekend.
phrases.nuance_ko: 학습과 관련해 가장 자주 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common phrase related to studying it.

explain_en: Current official term, treating signing as a full language. It used to be called '수화', but '수어' is now the official word. 한국수어 is not Korean moved onto the hands; it is a separate language with its own grammar. A signer is a '수어 사용자'.
